title: The more I work on applying Gee's affinity spaces to #IndieWeb and #ds106 the less I like the term knowledge brokering, I know how sociologist use it.
summary: The more I work on applying Gee's affinity spaces to #IndieWeb and #ds106 the less I like the term knowledge brokering, I know how sociologist use it. I get it, but connotations of power imbalance and manipulation, even towards shared endeavor feels wront.
